def settle(inp):
  os=[list(x) for x in inp]
  for t in range(80):
    oklist=[]
    for i,o in enumerate(os):
      d=1 if o[2]==2 else -1
      nc=o[1]+d
      if nc<0 or nc+4>=22: oklist.append(False);continue
      new=[o[0],nc,o[2],o[3]]
      oklist.append(not any(i!=j and overlap(new,p) for j,p in enumerate(os)))
    if not any(oklist): break
    for i,ok in enumerate(oklist):
      if ok: os[i][1]+=1 if os[i][2]==2 else -1
  return [(o[0],o[1]) for o in os]
